verdict.rationale: The Measurement Protocol docs mention devices "where automatic collection is not available", which implies GA4 has its own automatic collection on standard web and app streams. A community post confirms pageviews are captured as a 'page_view' event. Setup only requires adding the Google tag code once (docs-35), but no evidence says which interactions are auto-captured. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that clicks and form interactions are captured automatically (e.g., an enhanced-measurement feature list), detail on configuring or limiting autocapture, and hands-on corroboration that it works without per-event code.
